digest.component_or_area: transition command and library close-reason/force plumbing
propositions: Close-reason and force logic is duplicated across CLI (transition.py:584), library (_lib_writes.py:318), and MCP (_mcp_writes.py:224-232) with inconsistent admission rules: CLI refuses inadmissible reasons while library silently discards them

The placeholder string '(no reason given)' is produced in five code locations across three files with no single canonical definition, violating the guard requirement that the literal appear in exactly one producing expression
MCP transition_ticket does not expose reason parameter, causing strict-xfail in write-parity test, and reason data is accepted under one name and never read (bug defiant-orthoclase-buck pattern)
CLI accepts bare --force on reason-required classes while library behavior differs, requiring normalization of empty-reason to placeholder before refusal check to preserve acceptance
The three rule instances are not interchangeable: no merge leaves all pinning tests green due to CLI refuse/library-discard asymmetry on inadmissible reasons and target_status gate difference
